provenance.title: Angle-dependent pair production in the polarized two-photon Breit-Wheeler process
provenance.authors: Qian Zhao,1 Yan-Xi Wu,1, 2 Mamutjan Ababekri,1 Zhong-Peng Li,1 Liang Tang,3, ∗and Jian-Xing Li1, †

candidates.statement: Fundamentally, the angular modulations, both in polar and azimuthal directions, originate from the total helicity of the Λγ = 0, ±2 two-photon system, which must be transferred to the orbital angular momentum of the e+e−pair [2, 4].

In the c.m. frame, the polarization basis of γ(2) must ﬁrst be transformed to that of γ(1), which involves modifying the Stokes parameters of γ(2) as follows: ξ(2) 1 →−ξ(2) 1 , ξ(2) 2 → −ξ(2) 2 , ξ(2) 3 →ξ(2) 3 .
candidates.section_title: B Constructing polarized LBW process with MC sampling

candidates.statement: (15) To take into account the eﬀects of linear polarization of photons, the Stokes parameters ξ(1) and ξ(2), which are deﬁned in the basis (ˆθ, ˆφ), must be transformed to the basis (o(1), o(2)) with a counter-clockwise rotation by an angle ϕ.
candidates.section_title: B Constructing polarized LBW process with MC sampling
